text:
```yaml
name: Lint

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
      - develop
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
      - develop

jobs:
  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        php-version: ['8.4']

    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v2
    - name: Set up PHP ${{ matrix.php-version }}
      uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
      with:
        php-version: ${{ matrix.php-version }}
        extensions: dom, pcntl, xmlwriter
        tools: composer:v2

    - name: Cache Composer dependencies
      uses: ramsey/composer-install@v3
      with:
        working-directory: .

    - name: Add laravel/pint as dev dependency
      run: composer require laravel/pint:^1.22 --dev

    - name: Create pint.json configuration
      run: |
        echo '{
          "preset": "laravel",
          "rules": {
            "no_unused_imports": false
          }
        }' > pint.json

    - name: Run Pint to fix code style issues
      run: vendor/bin/pint --test

    - name: Commit changes (commented out)
      # run: git add .
      # run: git config --global user.name 'GitHub Actions'
      # run: git config --global user.email 'actions@github.com'
      # run: git commit -m "chore(laravel): apply code style fixes using Pint"
      # run: git push origin HEAD:$GITHUB_REF
```
